[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Talriss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] officer in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He served under [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Seeral Korrd|Korrd]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan]].<ref name="TOR" />
